edits.old: Then nothing is read or written
edits.new:
Then nothing is read or written

  Scenario: AC14 Result date after today (legacy RWB-E2-006 AC6, result date case)
    Given an approved restructure plan on treatment "TRT-SYN-0610"
    When the officer records NLEADS reference "NL-SYN-000610", result "APPROVED", approval level "L6" and a result date after today
    Then the response is refused with message MSG-GEN-002
    Then the treatment and the route state do not change

  Scenario: AC15 Approval level below the plan level (legacy RWB-E2-006 AC7)
    When the officer records NLEADS reference "NL-SYN-000610", result "APPROVED" and approval level "L5"
    Then the response is refused with message MSG-P2-018
    Then the treatment and the route state do not change

  Scenario: AC16 Role without the right records a result (legacy RWB-E2-006 access case)
    Given a role without the Treatment and offer right is signed in
    When the role records a result for the treatment
    Then the response is refused with message MSG-P4-002
    Then nothing is read or written

  Scenario: AC17 Case boundary and single result (BR4, BR10, BR11, BR12)
    Given case "RW-2026-000610" already has a recorded result
    When the officer records a second result for its treatment
    Then the second result is refused with message MSG-P2-010 and no second decision record is written
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock returns the NLEADS decision from "v_ace_credit_decision"
    Then rwb-case reads the NLEADS decision only through the rwb-source-data contract
    Then the case links to ACE and to the treatment by "account_key" and "treatmentId" only
    Then the route state, the queue and the owner are written only through the rwb-case interface

  Scenario: AC18 Error answers of the provided operations
    Given a call to a provided operation is made without a valid signed-in session
    Then the response is 401
    Given a call is made by a signed-in role without the access it needs
    Then the response is 403
    Given a call is made for a case that does not exist
    Then the response is 404

  Scenario: AC19 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given the officer has recorded result "APPROVED" with reference "NL-SYN-000610" and approval level "L6"
    When the same write is replayed with the same idempotency key
    Then the replay returns the outcome of the first write
    Then no second decision record is written
